citation.title: Oblique electron-cyclotron-emission radial and phase detector of rotating magnetic islands applied to alignment and modulation of electron-cyclotron-current-drive for neoclassical tearing mode stabilization
citation.authors: F. Volpe; M. E. Austin; G. Campbell; T. Deterly

topic: Analog real-time use of uncalibrated two-channel oblique ECE on DIII-D. Used to phase-lock and modulate ECCD to rotating NTM O-points and to check radial alignment.
own_question: Can oblique ECE, viewed along an ECCD-equivalent line of sight, toroidally and radially localize rotating islands for ECCD control?
actual_method_and_evidence: Two-channel heterodyne radiometer (108.25/111.25 GHz). Analog subtractor, comparator and microcontroller-programmed phase shifter, with near-flat phase reported over 1–7 kHz. Example DIII-D discharges show modulated ECCD correlated with Mirnov signals. A phase jump between channels coincided with ECCD/q=3/2 alignment. The paper shows these as examples only; it gives no statistical validation and makes no comparison to estimators.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Uncalibrated ECE voltage fluctuations have been used directly in real-time analog control without temperature calibration (DIII-D example).
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Sec. V; Sec. III B; Fig. 4
claim_checks.qualification: This concerns electron emission for NTM/ECCD phase control. It is not ion-temperature or CES nowcasting.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Online analog signal path. Mode frequencies of 1–10 kHz, with video bandwidth stated as sufficient. These timings are not comparable to our 10 ms grid.
validation_if_relevant: Example discharges only; no held-out design.
forbidden_inferences: Evidence for BES/ECEI predicting CES impurity Ti
Calibrated Te from raw voltages generally
Achieved NTM stabilization performance from this paper alone
Prior work in general is electron-only
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most an optional analogy for real-time use of raw uncalibrated voltage signals. Exclude from the core framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
